title: Old pictures and the WPA band
summary: He lacks old pictures and had quit before the WPA band.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: I wondered if you saved any of the old pictures. Do you have that one picture there with Clarence Williams and all. I have a copy of that I got from Johnny St. Cyr. Do you have any other old pictures that you saved from the bands?
Well, I had one I'd give it to my cousin. I had a good picture. Most I got now I did my own pictures. So I got some of them if you want to look at that. Yeah, didn't I?

There was one picture I saw once with your tuxedo band with the... in a book that was published one time. I didn't know if you still had that one or not. Oh, I was going to ask you, did you ever play in that big, during the Depression, that big WPA band, you know, they had. Did you ever play in that?
I was out then. I quit. You'd quit by that time already? I quit. I didn't switch.

About what year was that you quit? 1931 or when was it? About 31. About 31 then. Yes. Yes, that was then before the WPA band. Who did you say you loaded his car with, the saxophone player you said? With all the sheet music and that?

Yeah, I did medicine. Who was that? I don't know. He didn't know the boy. No? I didn't. I just forgot it. And he asked me if I had that, I gave him something up on the music yet, man. And I said, come up there, we got out of my beer. And I gave him everything. I didn't want nothing to do with it.
